workflows.name: tutorial-linear-pipeline
workflows.description: Simplest workflow pattern: human fills a form, a script processes it, done. Demonstrates params, script-container with inlineScript, and basic transitions.

workflows.name: tutorial-review-loop
workflows.description: Agent generates content, human reviews it. Approve advances to done; revise sends it back to the agent. Demonstrates agent steps, autonomyLevel, review verdicts, and the approve/revise loop pattern.

workflows.name: tutorial-conditional-branching
workflows.description: Route a request to different paths based on data. Demonstrates decision steps, 'when' expressions with comparisons, the 'else' catch-all, and multiple paths converging on a single terminal.

workflows.name: tutorial-script-variants
workflows.description: Chain script steps with different runtimes — JavaScript, Python, and Bash. Each step reads the previous step's output and transforms it further. Demonstrates runtime selection, data passing between scripts, and the script config block.

workflows.name: tutorial-script-r-clinical
workflows.description: Use R for clinical data analysis within a workflow. Demonstrates R runtime in script-container, reading step input, computing summary statistics with base R, and writing structured JSON output. Essential pattern for pharma workflows where R is the validated statistical environment.

workflows.name: tutorial-action-steps
workflows.description: Workflow-level side effects without scripts or agents. Demonstrates action executor with http (API call), reshape (data transformation), and email (notification). Actions are declarative — the engine executes them directly.

workflows.name: tutorial-env-secrets-databricks
workflows.description: Using environment variables and secrets in workflows. Shows top-level env block, per-step env overrides, {{SECRET}} interpolation syntax for platform-managed secrets, and a Databricks job step. Secrets are stored in the platform and injected at runtime — never hardcoded.

workflows.name: tutorial-trigger-input
workflows.description: Demonstrates the unified Trigger Input contract (ADR-0012) across every field type it supports: string, number, boolean, date, datetime, select, multiselect, textarea and object. triggerInput is the workflow's total input contract and every trigger validates against it, so ${triggerPayload.<field>} reads identically no matter which one fired. Start it by hand (the Start Run form renders one widget per type, including a JSON textarea for `object`), POST {"source":"edc","priority":"urgent","domains":["AE"],"sourceRecord":{"subjectId":"S-014"}} to its webhook, or attach a cron row carrying that same object as its static payload — all three produce the same triggerPayload, and a field the firing omits falls back to its declared `default` on every path. Triggers themselves are independent table resources managed via `mediforce workflow trigger-*` (ADR-0011, Issue #932).

workflows.name: tutorial-selection-review
workflows.description: Fetch a list of options via script, then let a human pick one from the results. Demonstrates the selection review pattern: a script outputs an options array, a review step with selection: 1 presents them for picking, and verdicts route the choice.

workflows.name: tutorial-cowork-step
workflows.description: Collaborative human+AI step using the cowork executor. A human and a chat agent work together in real time to produce a structured artifact. Demonstrates cowork config: agent type, systemPrompt, outputSchema, and chat model selection.

workflows.name: tutorial-validation-gate
workflows.description: Script validates data, then conditional routing passes or loops back for fixes. Demonstrates the validation gate pattern: a script step outputs {valid: true/false, errors: [...]}, transitions branch on output.valid, and the fix step feeds corrections back.

workflows.name: tutorial-fan-out-orchestration
workflows.description: Parent workflow that fans a child workflow out to every item in a list, waits for a collection window, then gathers the replies. Demonstrates action spawn with forEach (${item.*}), the wait action, and ${steps.*} interpolation. Distilled from apps/team-pulse.

workflows.name: tutorial-previous-run
workflows.description: Round-trips a message between runs: a script step reads `previousRun.message` from /output/previous_run.json, a human step sets the message the next run will see. Demonstrates the inputForNextRun carry-over contract and the empty-object first-run case.
